item.title: Davao radio broadcaster convicted for online harassment
item.description: DAVAO CITY, Philippines – A local court found Jun Digamon, broadcaster and station manager of Brigada News FM Davao, guilty of online sexual harassment, who was later arrested on Monday for failing to appear on court for the promulgation. item.title: Rights groups condemn conviction of community journalist Cumpio and lay worker Domequil
item.description: DAVAO CITY, Philippines – Journalist Frenchie Mae Cumpio and lay worker Marielle Domequil were acquitted today January 22 of charges of illegal possession of firearms and explosives, but were convicted for financing terrorism. The decision, handed by Judge Georgina Perez of the Regional Trial Court Branch 45 in Tacloban, stunned human rights and press freedom advocates, […]

item.title: Councilors condemn taxi driver’s harassment of student
item.description: DAVAO CITY, Philippines – Two Davao City councilors condemned the alleged sexual harassment by a taxi driver on his senior high school passenger, as they urged authorities to probe and file charges on the erring offender.
